normalized.answer: The words differ only by the ellipsis glyph ('...' in 2002, '…' in 2023); otherwise exact. No requirement differs; SR-14.9.28.3-7 is the right pointer.

cross-reference.answer: Read §2002:8.8.4: the same seven simple-condition kinds (relation, boolean, class, condition-name, switch-status, sign, omitted-argument) and the same negated/combined/abbreviated forms as 2023 8.8.4, whose additions are only 2023 operand classes. Scope unchanged; omitted-argument is unshown at every edition (the row's own gap).

band-formats.answer: The 2002 PERFORM has two formats, out-of-line and inline (§2002:14.8.27.1), with one unbanded syntax-rule list; they are 2023 formats 1 and 2 phrase for phrase (2023 adds UNTIL EXIT and format 3, both absent from 2002). The 2023 band FORMATS 1 AND 2 therefore reaches every 2002 PERFORM; no 2002 format falls outside it. SR8 governs condition-1/condition-2 in either format.
